title: AI How-To Video Maker for Your Products | Aidreamcapes
description: Use this AI how-to video maker to show your product in use, made from a single photo. Pick 9:16 for YouTube Shorts or 16:9 for your store page. Try it now.
h1: AI How-To Video Maker for Showing Products in Action
lead: Show shoppers how your product works in 10 or 15 seconds. Upload a photo, describe the task, and get a vertical or widescreen video for your store and YouTube Shorts.
intro: Here, your product gets used the way a customer would use it at home. The sample clip shows a woman running a handheld steamer down a creased blue shirt that hangs on a wooden clothes rack.

A quick how-to answers the question most shoppers have before they buy: how does this actually work? It suits tools and gadgets with one clear job, like garment steamers, milk frothers, lint shavers, or cleaning brushes. Put a 16:9 version on your product page and a 9:16 one on YouTube Shorts, then let the clip do the explaining.
tip: Describe one task from start to finish, like "steams a wrinkled cotton shirt on a hanger, collar to hem," instead of listing every feature.

steps.t: Upload the product on its own
steps.d: A clear photo of the steamer, frother, or tool against a plain background helps it keep its shape in the video.
Say who is using it, where, and what they do. Choose 10 seconds for a quick demo or 15 to slow it down.
Type short labels like "Fill," "Heat," and "Steam" in CapCut or Canva so the order is easy to follow.

ideas.d: Show a milk frother foaming a latte or a garlic press working through a clove, one job per clip.
Place a 16:9 version in your Shopify product description so buyers see the item in use before they add it to cart.
Make a few 10-second clips, each showing a different use, and post them on YouTube Shorts over a week.

faq.q: Can one video show several steps in a row?
faq.a: Keep it to one clear task. At 10 or 15 seconds, steaming a single shirt reads better than a full laundry routine. For a longer guide, make a few clips and join them in your editing app.

faq.q: Will the video include spoken instructions?
faq.a: No. Aidreamcapes doesn't add a voiceover or music. If you want narration, record it yourself and add it in CapCut or another editing app along with any step text.

faq.q: Does the video have to match how my product really works?
faq.a: Yes. Describe the real way your product is used and watch the clip before you post it. If it shows something your product can't do, generate it again with a clearer description.
